audit_title: QuantEngine Phase 172 Independent Audit & Post-Cost Execution Validation Findings

findings.summary: Deterministic queue-aware paper execution state machine operates with zero live exchange boundary exposure
findings.description: Implemented core/paper_trading/queue_aware_paper_engine.py modeling CREATED -> VALIDATED -> RESTING -> PARTIALLY_FILLED -> FILLED lifecycle alongside valid terminal rejections (REJECTED_POST_ONLY, REJECTED_STALE, REJECTED_CONSTRAINTS). Verified zero live adapter or credential reach via assert_no_live_adapter_invocation().
findings.mitigation: Enforced non-bypassable architectural isolation ensuring paper orders cannot invoke exchange REST/WS transport.

findings.summary: Asymmetric execution economics and instrument constraints formalized with Decimal precision
findings.description: Implemented calculate_asymmetric_round_trip and validate_instrument_constraints in core/execution/maker_execution_model.py supporting independent entry/exit fee tiers (e.g. Maker entry at 2.36 bps effective, Taker exit at 5.90 bps effective), tick size, lot step, and GST accounting.
findings.mitigation: Financial accounting uses Decimal arithmetic and explicit FeeScheduleProvenance records.

findings.summary: FrictionHurdleGate integrated into historical backtester decision boundary measures trade-selection effects
findings.description: Wired FrictionHurdleGate into core/backtesting/post_cost_backtester.py before order dispatch. Tested across 6 representative trade setups: Taker execution rejects 5/6 setups (83.3% rejected; only swing and trend setups pass), whereas Asymmetric Maker entry / Taker exit rejects 4/6 setups (66.7% rejected; standard intraday 150pt target passes). Micro-scalps (<50 pts) fail under all execution styles.
findings.mitigation: Preserved TradeSelectionTally tracking reasons for rejection without silently dropping failed candidates.

findings.summary: Granular queue dynamics model distinguishes 8 metrics and separates simulation assumptions from empirical observations
findings.description: In core/research/queue_dynamics.py, separated P(any fill) = 86.47% from P(complete fill) = 86.20%, expected time to first fill = 5.00s, time to complete fill = 5.05s, expected filled quantity = 0.86 contracts, expiration probability = 13.80%, adverse selection = 0.0164 USD, and unfilled opportunity cost = 0.0207 USD. Explicitly labeled SIMULATION_ASSUMPTION.
findings.mitigation: Theoretical Poisson arrival models are kept strictly distinct from observed venue fill probabilities.

findings.summary: Repository historical data coverage limited to 1,440 continuous 1m bars and 113 L2 updates
findings.description: Historical audit confirms data/history/BTCUSDT/1m.parquet contains exactly 1,440 rows (2026-09-05T21:35:00Z to 2026-09-06T21:34:00Z = 24 hours), and research/captures/phase167_recon/l2/delta_ob_updates_archive.json contains 113 frames. Continuous multi-year 2024-2026 tick-level depth is absent from repo and marked BLOCKED_EVIDENCE.
findings.mitigation: Simulations outside the verified 1,440-minute window are classified as scenario sensitivity bounds, not empirical proof.

findings.summary: Reconciliation of upstream hypothesis audit passing status vs historical change-detector failures
findings.description: Reconciled apparent discrepancy: test_upstream_hypothesis_audit.py executes 14 unit tests (coercion boundary, conditionality, Sidak without reset) all passing (14/14 OK). The 5 change-detector failures (BLOCK-172-01) reside in distinct test modules (test_oos_feasibility_17, test_oos_validation_18, test_oos_data_extension_19, test_readiness_16). Both statements are accurate and mutually consistent.
findings.mitigation: Documented exact pytest node IDs and collection scopes in reports/PHASE172_TEST_RESULTS.json.
